blurb: Felix Prehn is a former investment banker turned retail-finance educator and founder of the Goat Academy, a community he describes as aiming to make one million people financially independent. He publishes daily stock-market commentary via podcast, Substack, and X, with a focus on macro-driven equity themes, momentum screening, and accessible explanations of institutional-grade analysis. His style favours pattern-recognition and rules-based frameworks — consistent with a post that distils a CEO's earnings slide into a five-word signal.
credibility_note: Prehn's market commentary is educational rather than licensed investment advice. His background as a former banker is self-reported and not independently verified in public records. Content is broadly accessible and retail-oriented; track record of specific calls is not audited externally.
